newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends up in brisk trade before holiday.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends up in brisk trade before holiday.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed up and near session highs as fund buying lifted prices in brisk, pre-holiday trade.

Trade scale-up selling capped the rally at 76.10 cents a lb for most-active March contract. March settled 0.92 cent higher at 76.07 cents after trading from 76.13 to 75.55 cents. December ended up 1.03 at 74.70, while deferreds finished 0.95 to 0.15 higher.
Open interest in the December contract fell 51 lots to 1,306 lots as of Tuesday. Dec 6 is the final trading day for the contract.
NYCE will be closed Thursday and Friday in observance of U.S. Thanksgiving.
